note: 2026-11-13 dependency remediation: openidconnect 4.1.0 upgrades the curve family to 0.14 and resolves crypto-bigint 0.7.11, above the RustSec patched floor 0.7.6. The synthetic ES256 fixture also uses p256 0.14, removing the old vulnerable dev-only 0.5.5 copy from the full lockfile. Compared upstream verification operations and retained the unchanged auth.rs owner. Removed the RUSTSEC-2026-0387 ignore; the gate rejects vulnerable versions, drift, bypass consumers and reinstated ignores. This is scoped to this advisory, not a general cryptographic safety claim. Existing 2026-11-18 review deadline remains unchanged. Integration reassessment source combines the explicit resource-audience selector with OIDC 4.1.0; the selector changes only exact introspection audience matching, without adding signing, decryption, client assertions, or a cryptographic consumer. Independent exact-source review is required before adoption. 2026-11-13 optional inbound authentication amendment: independently reviewed the frozen auth.rs change adding only AuthMode selection and unauthenticated session metadata. Configured OIDC still takes precedence; invalid or unavailable selected OIDC is refused rather than falling back. Production token exchange, ID-token verification, introspection client authentication and JWKS/public-key operations are unchanged. The starter principal adds no private RSA signing/decryption, JWE, client assertion or additional cryptographic consumer. Locked openidconnect 4.1.0/rsa 0.9.10 and patched crypto-bigint graph checks passed for proxy and both binding workspaces. This updates only the reviewed adapter fingerprint/applicability note, not vulnerability status, ignore policy or the existing 2026-11-18 expiry. Full combined-source release review and tests remain separate.
